draft.summary: Ukraine's SBU said its drones hit oil and port facilities at Ust-Luga overnight on November 11, damaging tanks at the Novatek-Ust-Luga and Ust-Luga Oil terminals. Ukraine's General Staff said five tanks with a combined capacity of 150,000 cubic meters were damaged and a hydrocracking unit was on fire. Russian Leningrad governor Aleksandr Drozdenko confirmed drone strikes and a fire in the port area, and said a transformer substation was shut down.
